pr_title: Added a play next button to the long press menu
pr_body:
#### What is it? - [ ] Bugfix (user facing) - [x] Feature (user facing) - [ ] Codebase improvement (dev facing) - [ ] Meta improvement to the project (dev facing) #### Description of the changes in your PR Adds a play next button in the long press menu of a video, as asked for in #4136. - add getPlayerNextIntent in NavigationHelper - handle not Append Only Intent in Player class - add nextOn*Player functions in NavigationHelper - create new StreamDialogEntry: next - add new entry to the BaseListFragment - add Strings for names #### Before/After Screenshots/Screen Record
Before After
#### Fixes the following issue(s) - Fixes #4136 - Fixes #6026 #### APK testing The APK can be found by going to the "Checks" tab below the title. On the left pane, click on "CI", scroll down to "artifacts" and click "app" to download the zip file which contains the debug APK of this PR. #### Due diligence - [x] I read the [contribution guidelines](https://github.com/TeamNewPipe/NewPipe/blob/HEAD/.github/ONTRIBUTING.md). #### Critique / Todo - remove my comments - reduce code duplication - add translation strings

#### Describe the feature you want
<!-- A clear and concise description of what you wish should happen.
Example: *I think it would be nice if you add feature Y which makes X possible.*

Optionally, also describe alternatives you've considered.
Example: *Z is also a good alternative. Not as good as Y, but at least...* or *I considered Z, but that didn't turn out to be a good idea because...* -->

A „pre-queue“ option would appear in the context-menu of a video only when there is a active stream already. Pressing it would play the video immediately and shift the media played before toching the button (and all enqueued) below it in the queue.

(Maybe it would be possible to remember the progress of the before consumed stream and skip there, after a video is finished?)
#### Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe it

<!-- Add any other context, like screenshots, about the feature request here.
Example: *Here's a photo of my cat!* -->



#### How will you/everyone benefit from this feature?
<!-- Convince us! How does it change your NewPipe experience and/or your life?

Example: *This feature will help us colonize the galaxy! -->
It is for watching a video when you have listened to something else before and want to continue afterwards
